digest.component_or_area: git subprocess timeout bounding across network-capable call sites
propositions: Network-capable git call sites in gerrit_client.py and workspace.py lack explicit timeouts and can block indefinitely on stuck remotes or hung credential helpers
subprocess.TimeoutExpired in gerrit_client.clone_change_ref is not caught by existing exception handlers and leaks credential tokens in error messages
workspace._git helper lacks timeout parameter, leaving all git calls in the module unbounded
ref_lock.py already enforces timeouts structurally via required keyword-only timeout parameter and needs no modification
Two command-module sites (init.py fetch, fsck_repair.py push) are deferred to separate task 983f pending resolution of conflicting changes in task 01e8
